_about: Scout's weekly report: what's hot inside services people already pay for. Real, dated, sourced picks only. At most one pick per service per week. Refresh weekly (checked 2026-11-25, Wednesday run).

items.title: "The Body" is now Netflix's #1 English show
items.text: 9.5 million views in the week of Nov 16, rising to the top in its second week. It's already in your Netflix plan.

items.title: "BbY WOW" by KAROL G, Judeline and rusowsky is still #1 on Spotify worldwide
items.text: About 32 million streams in the week of Nov 19, top of the Spotify Global weekly chart again. Free to play with your Spotify plan.
items.src: Spotify Global weekly chart via Soundcharts, week of Nov 19, 2026

items.title: "Mickey's Home Alone" holiday special streams Friday
items.text: Mickey's new holiday special comes to Disney+ on Friday, Nov 27, the day after its Disney Jr. debut. A fun pick for the kids this holiday weekend, included with Disney+.
items.src: The Main Street Mouse, New on Disney+ Thanksgiving weekend 2026
